mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the skin layers was most worthwhile: the nutrient arrows showed how living epidermal cells receive supplies from vessels beneath them, alongside the barrier and touch functions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the finished skin to the body felt least engaging because it was the only offered combination and its result was predictable.

surprise.text: The description showed that blood vessels stop below the epidermis while nutrients still reach its living cells.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each had a clear role in building or connecting the skin. Most choices after the first were the only offered combinations.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it offered more meaningful choices. The connections between structures and their functions were clear, but the sequence became predictable.
